anmelden_fehler: Sign-in failed. Check your name and password.
registrieren_fehler: The account could not be created. Check your details.
registrieren_vergeben: There is already an account for this e-mail. Sign in instead.
fehler_netz: No connection to the server. Try again in a moment.
fehler_speichern: This could not be saved. Check your details.
fehler_arbeitszeit_pflicht: Working time stays on while the business has employees (duty to record, BAG 1 ABR 22/21).
fehler_betrag: Enter an amount in euros, such as 3,200.00 or 13.90.
einladung_text: Hello {name}, you are invited to {betrieb} as {rolle}. Choose a username and a password; you need no e-mail address.
einladung_benutzername_hinweis: 3 to 30 characters: letters, digits, dot and underscore
einladung_fehler: The invitation could not be accepted. Check your details.
einladung_vergeben: This username is taken. Choose another one.
einladung_ungueltig: This link no longer works: it has expired, was used already or is unknown. Ask for a new one.
einrichtung_module_spaeter: · can be changed later under Settings
betrieb_text: The federal state sets the public holidays. Four questions decide what you see in Soll.
fragen_titel: Four questions, so you only see what you need
frage_schichten: Do you work in shifts or to a plan?
frage_kunden: Do you bill hours to customers?
frage_stempelort: Do you clock in at a fixed place, such as the entrance?
modul_arbeitszeit_text: Clocking in, checks against the Working Hours Act, closing the month, absences
modul_terminal_text: A tablet at the entrance for clocking in with a PIN
module_text: What your business uses. A module switched off leaves the navigation; its data stays.
standorte_text: Where people work. Each site gets the public holidays of its state and municipality.
standort_name_hinweis: Such as workshop, café or Altona branch
modelle_text: Pick the templates that fit and change only what differs.
vorlage_vollzeit_text: Spread evenly Monday to Friday · monthly salary
vorlage_teilzeit_text: Spread evenly Monday to Friday · hourly wage
vorlage_minijob_text: Hours by plan · hourly wage · recorded within 7 days (§ 17 MiLoG)
modell_lohn_hinweis: May stay empty and follow later
modell_fehlt: Use at least one working-time model.
mitarbeiter_text: Read a list from your spreadsheet or add people one by one. They are invited in the next step.
mitarbeiter_leer: Nobody added yet. You can also invite later.
csv_kein_kopf: Line {zeile}: the first line needs a column Name (or first and last name).
csv_zu_viele: Line {zeile}: at most 200 people at once.
csv_name_zu_lang: Line {zeile}: the name is longer than 100 characters.
csv_rolle_unbekannt: Line {zeile}: Soll does not know the role “{wert}”.
einladungen_text: Each person gets a link. Pass it on, for example in a chat; no e-mail address is needed.
einladungen_leer: Nobody on the list. You can invite later.
hinweis_pflicht: With employees, working time is required: working time must be recorded (BAG, 13.09.2022, 1 ABR 22/21).
hinweis_solo: Without employees you record project time only. If someone joins, Soll switches working time on.
hinweis_feiertage: A site in Bavaria, Saxony or Thuringia may have holidays of its municipality, such as the Peace Festival in Augsburg.
hinweis_terminal_standort: The terminal stands at a site: everyone clocks in there with their PIN.
hinweis_vorlagen: Durations in hours and minutes, wages in euros and cents. Soll checks the minimum wage per person later.
hinweis_dienstplan_soll: With the rota, the hours come from the shifts, as in a mini-job.
hinweis_csv_vorlage: One line per person, the first with the columns, such as: Name;Role. Without a role, Employee applies.
hinweis_links_einmal: You see the links only now. Each works for seven days and only once.
hinweis_terminal_pin: For the terminal you then give each person a PIN.
hinweis_danach_stempeln: Next: under Today everyone clocks in, takes breaks and clocks out.
hinweis_danach_dienstplan: Next: in the rota you plan the week's shifts.
hinweis_danach_projekte: Next: under Projects you add customers and jobs.
hinweis_danach_terminal: Next: the tablet at the entrance becomes the terminal; everyone clocks in there with their PIN.
